item.title: Kids falsely claim they were almost kidnapped: Greeley cop log
item.description: A caller reported their neighbor’s daughter was last to be dropped off at the bus stop near the intersection of 16th Street Road and 105th Avenue. The daughter claimed a man in a white van chased her with a gun and tried to kidnap her and other kids. Detectives confirmed the story was made up by the kids.

item.title: The Poudre River Trail’s final mile
item.description: Fred Otis not only found a place to finally enjoy the river; he was a big part in making it possible for the tens of thousands of Northern Colorado residents who run, bike and walk the Poudre River Trail. His nonprofit board on Weld County’s side joined with Larimer County, Fort Collins and many other towns to build a 45-mile path from Bellvue to Greeley. item.title: CSU Rams snap losing skid with win over San Jose State
item.description: FORT COLLINS — Colorado State snapped a three-game losing streak with a 65-57 victory over San Jose State on Saturday at Moby Arena. With the win, the Rams improved to 13-10 overall and 4-8 in the Mountain West Conference. They had lost eight of their previous 11 games prior to Saturday’s win over the Spartans.
